context: A married couple discusses planning a small home ceremony
purpose: Teach: しまえ/下さっ/除い/見つから/去っ/あけ/行なう/曰く

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あなた、来月うちでささやかな法事を行なうことにしましょうよ。プライベートな集まりにして、ご近所には知らせずに。
lines.en: Dear, let's hold a small memorial service at home next month. Let's make it a private gathering and not tell the neighbors.
lines.style: Warm and decisive, gentle wifely tone with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いいね。前にご夫妻が教えて下さった進め方を参考にしようか。確かお寺のご住職も呼ばれていたな。
lines.en: Sounds good. Shall we refer to the procedure that couple kindly taught us before? I recall the temple priest was invited too.
lines.style: Reflective fatherly voice, measured and warmly nostalgic.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ええ、でもうちは仏式にしましょう。あの静けさが、この家には特有のぬくもりで合うと思うの。
lines.en: Yes, but let's go with the Buddhist style. That quietness fits this house with a warmth all its own.
lines.style: Soft conviction, thoughtful and aesthetically minded.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そうだな。祖父曰く、形にこだわらず心を込めればいい、と。古い作法書がどこかにあったはずだが、見つからないんだよ。
lines.en: True. Grandfather used to say, don't fuss over form, just put your heart into it. There should be an old etiquette book somewhere, but I can't find it.
lines.style: Gentle older male voice, contemplative with a hint of mild frustration.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら、押し入れの奥かしら。年があけてから片付けたとき、いらない物を除いて箱にしまったはずよ。今夜さっと探してしまえばいいわ。
lines.en: Oh dear, perhaps deep in the closet. When I tidied after the new year, I packed it in a box after setting aside the things we didn't need. We can just give it a quick search tonight.
lines.style: Brisk practical wife, lightly amused, problem-solving tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 助かるよ。両親が去って以来、こうした行事はずいぶん久しぶりだ。懐かしい思い出が一気に蘇るな。
lines.en: That's a help. Since my parents passed, it's been quite a while since we held such an event. Fond memories come rushing back all at once.
lines.style: Soft and slightly somber, sincere middle-aged man.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: だからこそ大切よ。家族の遺産として、子供たちにも受け継いでほしいわ。
lines.en: That's exactly why it matters. As a family legacy, I want our children to carry it on too.
lines.style: Tender and resolute, motherly warmth with quiet emotion.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん。じゃあまずは準備として、座敷を片付けるところから始めよう。
lines.en: Right. Then as our first preparation, let's start by tidying up the tatami room.
lines.style: Calm fatherly resolve, gentle and forward-looking.
